main_text.head: Cap. 24. De interjectionibus.
Cum nominativo.
main_text.p: Interjectionum quæ Latinis appellantur, sua etiam rectio est, sed varia. Eurip. οἱ ἐγὼ μελέα, hei ego misera. Julian. epist. ὢ λόγος, ὢ φρένες, ὢ σωφροσύνη, ὢ ὑπερφρονήματα, ὢ ἁρμονία, ὢ σωφροσύνη [?], ô sermo, ô mentes, ô prudentia, ô epicheremata, ô concinnitas, ô compositio.
main_text.head: Cum genitivo.
main_text.p: Αἰ, φεῦ, ὢ, οἰ, ἰὼ, βαβαί. Favorin. αἰ αἰ τῆς νεογνῶν μου παιδίων, heu heu recens natos meos liberos. Soph. φεῦ τῆς θνῄσκοντος, heu mortuum. Aristophanes, ὦ μοι σοφίας, ô sapientiam: ὦ μοι μανίας τῆς σῆς, ô insaniam tuam. Lycia. οἴμοι τῶν κτημάτων, οἴμοι τ' ἀγρῶν, heu possessiones, heu agros. Suid. ἰὼ ἰὼ θαυμάτων ἐμπωδῶν, ô ô vulnera dolorifica. Favor. ὢ τῆς ἐμῆς ἀθλιότητος, ô mea ærumna.

page.notes: Greek accents and breathings are reproduced from a small, slightly blurred scan. The passages marked [?] and the Greek lines in the Julian and Suidas quotations are the least certain. The Suidas and Favorinus passages in particular may differ in some letters from the printed text.
